newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Vienna bourse suspends trade in BBAG, Brau Union.
newsitem.headline: Vienna bourse suspends trade in BBAG, Brau Union.

text.p: The Vienna Stock Exchange said on Friday it was suspending trade for the day in brewer group BBAG and its subsidiary Brau Union.
The bourse did not give any reason for the suspension of the two blue chips' shares which are listed on the ATX index.
The companies did not give any reason for the suspension.
According to recent media speculation a merger between Steirerbrau AG and Oesterreichische Brau AG, two units of the holding Brau-Union, could be in the pipeline.
Another rumoured possibility is that the two units could be merged with the holding. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12257
